lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Darling,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: you look rather down today.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Is someone giving you a hard time?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Tell me who it is, and I'll set them straight.
I'm actually in a pretty good mood today.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: You sure?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: You don't look as good as you did yesterday.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I can see it all over your face.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Your eyebrows are furrowed and everything.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: What are you keeping from me?
You can tell all that just by looking at my face?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Of course, I can.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I care about you more than anything,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: so please tell me the truth.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Why do you look so sad?
I guess I do feel kinda hungry...

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: So that's it!

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Well, as fortune would have it,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I happened to bring you something.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Turn around.
There is a box behind the chair

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Ta-dah! Apples! Picked them myself too,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: and they're all yours.
What the... When did you put these here?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Well, duty calls.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: See ya!
